business_problem: At the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, John Hancock's customer contact centers—like other customer contact centers around the world—saw a spike in traffic and the company sought ways to ensure their customers continued to get the answers they needed, when they needed them.
solution_summary: At the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, many companies' customer contact centers were overwhelmed due to shutdowns and resource constraints. At the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, John Hancock's customer contact centers—like other customer contact centers around the world—saw a spike in traffic and the company sought ways to ensure their customers continued to get the answers they needed, when they needed them. With its mission to give customers the confidence to make the right decisions, John Hancock dedicated itself to adopting a sustainable solution—for its customers and its call center representatives. The implementation centers on Azure AI Bot Service, Microsoft Teams, Azure to support customer service automation workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Bot Service
solution_components.role: Hosts the conversational bot experience used by service teams and end users.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, identity, and managed services for the solution.
